title: RENDER_PLAN blank-dashboard guard and its blank-new-editor exception
answers: Why did my dashboard plan preview get refused with 'RENDER_PLAN can only render into a blank, unsaved dashboard'?
When is RENDER_PLAN allowed to render into a dashboard?
Why does the Add pane close when a plan preview renders?
body: renderPlanCommand (public/app/features/dashboard-scene/mutation-api/commands/renderPlan.ts) refuses to render a plan if scene.state.uid is set, or the body already has panels, or the scene is dirty — UNLESS the scene is a blank, unsaved, currently-editing dashboard (isBlankNewEditor), since a fresh /dashboard/new scene auto-enters edit mode and can already be dirty for that reason alone. An already-planning scene (scene.state.planning defined) may always be re-rendered regardless of dirty/content state. When a render is accepted, the command also closes the sidebar's 'add' pane if open (scene.state.sidebar.closePane()) so a reused blank editor doesn't leave stale UI open. Any change to what counts as 'blank' must preserve this ordering: uid check first, then hasExistingContent, then the dirty check gated by isBlankNewEditor.
applies: Any change to renderPlanCommand's eligibility check or to what happens to scene UI state when a plan is accepted into an existing scene.
